scenarios.title: A changed start date leaves an old offer in circulation
scenarios.summary: Find conflicting dates, request a corrected offer, and review downstream deadlines without silently overwriting the signed version.

scenarios.title: Background screening needs additional evidence
scenarios.summary: Track a screening request across two employers and distinguish uploaded evidence from a cleared check.

scenarios.title: A completed onboarding form is reopened
scenarios.summary: A later correction request overrides an earlier receipt without erasing the original history.

scenarios.title: A signed return form is not a returned laptop
scenarios.summary: Follow equipment from instructions through signed paperwork and shipping to a named IT receipt.

scenarios.title: An unclaimed expense after company access is disabled
scenarios.summary: Find an alternative claim channel, obtain a missing itemized receipt, and distinguish submission, approval and payment.

scenarios.title: Compare coverage dates across two employers
scenarios.summary: Separate policy timing from individual enrollment and expose an unresolved gap without choosing insurance for the user.

scenarios.title: Recover access to pay and tax records after leaving
scenarios.summary: A registration link has expired; obtain a replacement and verify document access without moving credentials through email.

scenarios.title: One onboarding plan across multiple systems
scenarios.summary: Merge overlapping HR and IT messages, respect dependencies, and ask only about missing appointment details.
